quotes.text: I think the difference now is that seeing the evolutions of AI, which, quite frankly, are just starting, and there are going to be things we are going to be talking about in a decade we would not even be thinking about today in his hearing. I think it is more about making sure that kids going through the K-12 system primarily, but then also through higher education, are learning how to leverage AI and these tools to actually become far more productive, far more innovative, and then as a byproduct, having their labor be able to have a different set of value in the economy to come.
